integrated_design_coverage.requirement: ordered discovery vector and one terminal outcome per ID
integrated_design_coverage.architecture_mitigation: Seal a complete ordered vector before execution; maintain an exactly-once terminal ledger, explicitly expanding class, lifecycle, abort, and policy-blocked states.
integrated_design_coverage.rollback_or_failure_behavior: Duplicate, foreign, missing, contradictory, or post-start discovery/outcome data invalidates finalization; source artifacts remain as blocked evidence.

integrated_design_coverage.requirement: declared labels, parser grammar, raw-stream integrity, and summary reconciliation
integrated_design_coverage.architecture_mitigation: Bind versioned label vocabulary and JSONL grammar before discovery; retain protected raw-stream HMAC metadata and redacted stream hashes; reconcile summaries against the ledger rather than trusting text.
integrated_design_coverage.rollback_or_failure_behavior: Unknown labels, malformed or ambiguous events, stream mismatch, or summary disagreement yield invalid capture rather than a successful validation result.
integrated_design_coverage.design_status: partially specified; executable grammar and full label semantics remain material future-proposal obligations

integrated_design_coverage.requirement: immutable source, interpreter, environment, and authority binding
integrated_design_coverage.architecture_mitigation: Bind repository identity, commit/tree, tracked manifest, interpreter identity, sandbox, allowlisted environment digests, command, and governing-contract digest before launch.
integrated_design_coverage.rollback_or_failure_behavior: A changed source, executable, interpreter, environment, or authority binding blocks publication and preserves an aborted attempt.
integrated_design_coverage.design_status: partially specified; allowlisted fields and reproducible privacy-safe identity procedure remain material future-proposal obligations

integrated_design_coverage.architecture_mitigation: Redact before repository retention, retain typed placeholders and redaction metadata, fail closed on redaction failure, and make committed bundles append-only with signed tombstones for deletion/legal-hold events.
later_verification: privacy leak test across streams, environment, exceptions, and diagnostics
held-out delimiter and split-secret redaction cases
integrated_design_coverage.rollback_or_failure_behavior: Scanner failure, invalid encoding, or grammar-affecting redaction prevents finalization; new adapter rollback disables only the capability while preserving receipts and tombstones.
integrated_design_coverage.design_status: partially specified; protected raw-stream storage, encryption/access authority, and deletion model are unresolved

integrated_design_coverage.requirement: atomic receipt finalization and append-only retention
integrated_design_coverage.architecture_mitigation: Use exclusive session staging, fsync/hash verification, atomic same-filesystem rename, compare-and-swap index append, and reader verification of committed receipt, manifest, and index binding.
integrated_design_coverage.rollback_or_failure_behavior: Incomplete or orphaned files are quarantined, never reused; readers accept no partial bundle; adapter rollback preserves every prior receipt.
integrated_design_coverage.design_status: covered at contract level; durable storage abstraction remains material future-proposal work

integrated_design_coverage.requirement: bounded recovery, rollback, and non-recursive escalation
integrated_design_coverage.architecture_mitigation: Use append-only PREPARED through COMMITTED/BLOCKED transitions, new linked sessions for revalidation, one diagnosis and one remediation round per blocker signature, two automatic attempts by default, then ESCALATED decision evidence.
integrated_design_coverage.rollback_or_failure_behavior: No retry may overwrite, merge, hide, or replace a prior adverse/incomplete attempt; exhausted or sensitive remediation escalates without implementation/promotion conclusion.

integrated_design_coverage.requirement: separate candidate applicability and no cross-repository reuse
integrated_design_coverage.architecture_mitigation: Require exact candidate commit/tree, parent, component kind, changed-path digest, target binding, composition, authority, validation contract, and rollback reference; namespace receipts by repository/policy realm/worktree bindings.
integrated_design_coverage.rollback_or_failure_behavior: A rejected, quarantined, non-promoted, mixed-tree, or mismatched candidate fails before execution; no historic candidate can be implicitly composed or relabeled.

cross_examination_disposition.finding: Protected raw-stream storage, encryption/access authority, and deletion model are not precisely chosen.
cross_examination_disposition.architecture_response: Architecture establishes pre-retention redaction, protected raw-spool separation, retention policy, and tombstone behavior, but does not select a concrete protected-store design.
cross_examination_disposition.required_before_later_proposal_can_open: A precise privacy/storage threat model and repository-safe protected-stream retention/deletion design, including authorities and fail-closed behavior.

cross_examination_disposition.finding: Parser grammar, label semantics, canonicalization, and durable storage remain narrative rather than executable/specifiable artifacts.
cross_examination_disposition.architecture_response: Architecture names JSONL events, parser rejection rules, and canonical JSON, with mandatory grammar and adversarial tests, but provides no executable grammar, complete vocabulary, canonicalization test vectors, or storage interface.
cross_examination_disposition.required_before_later_proposal_can_open: Versioned executable grammar/vocabulary artifacts, canonicalization vectors, and a bounded durable-storage contract that can be independently reviewed.

cross_examination_disposition.finding: Environment allowlist and reproducible interpreter/executable identity are not defined without host-data leakage.
cross_examination_disposition.architecture_response: Architecture requires an allowlisted environment-name-to-digest map and interpreter metadata, but leaves the exact fields, normalization, and privacy-safe reproducibility procedure open.
cross_examination_disposition.required_before_later_proposal_can_open: A field-level allowlist, normalization/redaction rules, identity digest procedure, and held-out leakage/reproducibility cases.

cross_examination_disposition.finding: The current court supplies no implementation authority.
cross_examination_disposition.architecture_response: Both design inputs explicitly preserve this boundary.
cross_examination_disposition.required_before_later_proposal_can_open: A distinct Judge decision after all material design findings are resolved; no implementation follows directly.

non_negotiables_preserved.no_raw_secrets: Repository evidence stores redacted artifacts, typed placeholders, counts, and digests only; raw secret-bearing bytes are outside repository retention and need separate authority.
non_negotiables_preserved.atomic_receipt_finalization: Only manifest-verified, atomically renamed, index-bound committed bundles are evidence; staging and orphaned material are quarantined.
non_negotiables_preserved.immutable_identity_and_source_binding: Session IDs, source commit/tree, runner contract, interpreter, environment, and receipt lineage are immutable; revalidation opens a linked new session.
non_negotiables_preserved.bounded_recovery: Recovery is finite and stateful, with blocker signatures, a small retry/remediation budget, and escalation rather than recursive automatic courts.
non_negotiables_preserved.candidate_applicability: Candidate use is a separate exact predicate; prior fixture candidate 41950b74bdec2b6e1c48ee7f5ef3ce947d0c8378 and GCO candidate d02c2d2 remain adverse and ineligible for reuse, relabeling, qualification, or composition.
non_negotiables_preserved.cross_repository_isolation: Receipt/cache reuse requires matching repository fingerprint, source/tree, worktree, policy realm, interpreter, and contract; branch/path/name similarity is insufficient.
